steps.summary: Compared AstrBot streaming result, streaming finish marker, and platform send_streaming behavior.
Added MessageStream, streaming result builders, event streaming-finished state, and MessageSink::send_streaming.
RespondStage now routes streaming results to send_streaming, marks streaming finish, skips duplicates, and keeps regular send validators intact.
Added tests for streaming sink routing, stop control, finish markers, duplicate suppression, and recording sink stream history.
